description: Calculate the d-band center of the Pt(111) surface from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of the Pt(111) surface (FCC, Fm-3m). Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the surface Pt atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.

references: Ruban, Hammer, Stoltze, Skriver, and Norskov, J. Mol. Catal. A: Chem. 115, 421-429 (1997).
Takigawa, Shimizu, Tsuda, and Takakusagi, RSC Adv. 6, 52587-52595 (2016).
method.modeling: Use a clean close-packed Pt(111) slab and project the DOS on top-layer Pt atoms only.
method.rationale: The -2.25 eV target is the clean Pt close-packed-surface diagonal d-band center from the Ruban/Hammer/Norskov tables and the canonical Pt(111) reference in the Hammer-Norskov d-band model. The quantity is the surface-atom d-DOS centroid relative to E_F, matching the benchmark full_d_band_centers_rel_fermi_eV convention. This is a surface Pt value, not the bulk Pt d-band center. The 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers PAW projection, smearing, k-point convergence, and DOS integration-window differences.
